escalate.trigger: structural news
escalate.evidence: 8-K Item 1.01 (2026-10-21) and Ex.10.1: a new non-voting Class C class, a one-time Class C dividend on every A/B share effective 2027-01-19 (effectively 2-for-1), and a Founder Alignment Agreement. It changes control for public holders: the founder can sell 20% of his Class C at once and 2.5% a quarter more (32 quarters, conditional on full-time leadership) without reducing his majority voting power; the stated purpose of the class includes capital raising, acquisitions and employee pay, so future dilution can come in non-voting stock; and the Board must declare further 1:1 Class C dividends to all holders at each doubling of the $580.60 (2026-09-10) reference price with >=10% annualized return. Economics are not transferred: dividends are pro rata, Section 8 gives equal consideration in a sale and Section 7 commits best efforts to buy back Class C alongside Class A, and there is no award (the recitals present it in place of founder equity compensation). No fair-value effect; per-share figures halve from the payment date (kept pre-split here).
